note: USACE Saylorville Lake, tailwater area below the dam on the Des Moines River. Three areas: concrete back-ins 12-20 along the east bank of the river, 25 m or less of grass from the bank; a loop in the woods on the west bank (2-11); and the long main loop (21-69) at the foot of the dam, grassy, with no water in sight. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22-26, 50 amp, water, sewer, 67 sites, facilities; added no walk-ups, 14-night limit, senior pass. Riverview stands on sites 12-20; old note's road between sites and river was wrong for them.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (riverview stands, riverfront possible, and the road claim is wrong): rec.gov per-site plot on imagery. Sites 12, 14, 15, 17, 18 and 20 back onto the river's east bank: about 15-25 m of open grass with no road between (their access road is on the landward side), then a rock-lined bank; river about 80 m wide there. The old note's 'behind a road and riprap levee' doesn't hold for these. But the official photos of 14, 15, 17 and 20 show no water from the pad: pad, table, grass, then riprap, with the far side's cars and shelter beyond it. I read that riprap as the far bank seen over the channel, so the water sits below the sightline; I can't be sure, so I'm not proposing an upgrade. Sites 13, 16, 19 are across their access road. If AWH reads the bank as walkable, 12-20 would make it riverfront (9 bookable 50-amp sites). rec.gov: 'excellent views of the Des Moines River. Most campsites are within easy walking distance of the shore.'

BELOW THE DAM: the 49-site main loop (21-69) sits on the downstream side of the dam embankment, which fills the northern horizon in the official photos; no lake value. DEM about 255 m at the loop, and the lake lies beyond the embankment, so it is no use for a below-pool check; the dam axis settles it. No river view from it either (about 350 m away through trees). West loop 2-11: official photo of 04 shows road and dam, no water.

Sites 03, 11, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 are not reservable (status Not Available), so 60 bookable. Per-site lengths are blank on the catalog's Max Vehicle Length for most sites; RV max_length is what I used; all 60 bookable sites are at 43 ft or more on the samples read, and none under 23 ft. PIN about 100 m from the sites' centre (41.70175,-93.6836); fine. USACE district page refused plain HTTP (403), unread; rec.gov lists no closure notice. Season not stated.
